title: Sprint-to-Strategy Bridge: Exec Briefing & Decision Playbook
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Purpose: Prepare a concise executive packet and briefing for the upcoming QBR that translates sprint-level progress into strategic signals for execs and board. This ticket owns the 'Sprint-to-Strategy Bridge' artifact: a one-page brief that surfaces initiative health, runway risk lanes, recommended investment pivots, and explicit decision asks. Deliverables: 1) 1-page executive brief (PDF) 2) 10-slide readout deck with 3 decision slides 3) Risk heatmap and mitigation list 4) Recommended rollforward / rollback lanes with cost/delivery tradeoffs Key themes: - Translate near-term velocity and incidence data (SLO breaches, infra incidents) into leadership asks - Show customer impact and revenue-at-risk where applicable - Provide three concrete scenarios (No-change / Moderate-invest / Fast-track) with cost and ramp timelines Stakeholders: PMs (Platform, Runtime, Console), Eng leads, Design lead, Finance, Legal. Primary consumer: CEO + Board packet, with a condensed summary for Sales leadership. Context: We have seen two runtime incidents in Jan-Feb impacting latency for longer sequences; Dedicated capacity demand signals are tracking +18% MOM in a subset of enterprise tenants. The brief should highlight where to prioritize spend (capacity vs reliability vs observability) and recommend specific knobs (reserve capacity, prioritized routing policy, extra SRE rotation) along with expected ROI and timelines.
metrics: SLO breach count (Jan-Feb): 2 incidents affecting 4 customers
Enterprise reserved capacity signal: +18% M/M for top 20 tenants
decisions: Decision 1: Approve $350k incremental reserved capacity for Dedicated pilot (6 months) to handle enterprise demand spikes
Decision 2: Prioritize runtime SLO engineering lane 1: KV cache improvements (3 sprints) vs lane 2: kernel scheduling optimization (5 sprints) - recommend lane 1 first
Decision 3: Greenlight extended observability retention (90 days) for the pilot customers where we will run deeper regression analysis
